title: Telex Transfer does not work!
body:
I tried to transfer money to a non-Mashreq beneficiary from my list and the transfer was rejected. It asked me to enter a 'purpose of payment.' There is no option in your iPhone app to enter purpose of payment, and that's why the transfer does not go through. Please fix it! 

Thanks.
